The '''Duran system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Duran feather lily]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Journal8" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Duran [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-9.<ref name="TEA" />
